topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: Oh my gosh, can you even believe it? I found my old teddy, the one I used to carry everywhere, at this yard sale. You know, the one with the little red bow tie? He looked so... well, a bit worse for wear, like me after a sleepless night. I couldn't just leave him there, could I? So I brought him home, and the thing is, holding him again, it's like all these memories came rushing back. Every hug, every tear, every whispered secret. It's comforting, yet... I don’t know, it feels a bit like seeing an old friend after so long, and realizing how much time has passed. But I'm glad I found him, truly. Maybe it’s a sign, I don’t know. Just felt like I needed to tell someone.
